blocks.zh: 品質考量（第二部分）：BSE/TSE、品質系統、滅菌、完整性
blocks.en: Quality Considerations (Part 2): BSE/TSE, Quality Systems, Sterilization and Integrity

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解一次性系統（SUS）中 BSE/TSE 風險的來源與評估方法
blocks.en: Understand the sources of BSE/TSE risk in single-use systems (SUS) and how to assess it

blocks.zh: 掌握終端使用者與供應商品質系統的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Master the key elements of the end user and supplier quality systems

blocks.zh: 理解 SUS 的有效期限、微粒管控、生物負荷控制與滅菌方法
blocks.en: Understand SUS expiration dating, particulate control, bioburden control and sterilization methods

blocks.zh: 認識各種滅菌技術（照射、濕熱、氣體）的優缺點與適用場景
blocks.en: Know the advantages, disadvantages and suitable applications of the various sterilization technologies (irradiation, moist heat, gas)

blocks.zh: 掌握感測器技術在 SUS 中的應用與驗證要點
blocks.en: Master the application and validation points of sensor technology in SUS

blocks.zh: 理解 SUS 完整性測試與洩漏預防的實務策略
blocks.en: Understand practical strategies for SUS integrity testing and leak prevention

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Table of Contents
blocks.en: Table of Contents

blocks.zh: 5.7 Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE)/Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathy (TSE) Concerns 5.7 牛海綿狀腦病（BSE）/ 傳染性海綿狀腦病（TSE）疑慮
blocks.en: 5.7 Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE)/Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathy (TSE) Concerns

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: BSE/TSE（牛海綿狀腦病/傳播性海綿狀腦病）：這是一類由 Prion（乃變性蛋白）引起的致命性神經退化疾病。在製藥領域，任何含有動物來源成分的材料都必須評估是否有傳播此類疾病的風險。
blocks.en: BSE/TSE (Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy/Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathy): A group of fatal neurodegenerative diseases caused by prions (misfolded proteins). In pharmaceutical manufacturing, any material containing animal-derived components must be assessed for the risk of transmitting these diseases.

blocks.zh: Calcium Stearate（硬脂酸鈣）：從牛脂（Tallow）衍生的添加劑，常用作塑膠的脫模劑或滑劑。雖然只有微量存在，但仍需要進行風險評估。
blocks.en: Calcium Stearate: An additive derived from bovine tallow, commonly used as a mold-release agent or lubricant in plastics. Although it is present only in trace amounts, a risk assessment is still required.

blocks.zh: Tallow（牛脂）：將牛脂肪以蒸氣處理後，再經氫氧化鈉皂化反應而成。經過高溫（≥200°C）高壓至少20分鐘的嚴格加工程序，已大幅降低 BSE/TSE 感染風險。
blocks.en: Tallow: Produced by steam treatment of bovine fat followed by saponification with sodium hydroxide. The rigorous processing (high temperature of ≥200°C and high pressure for at least 20 minutes) greatly reduces the risk of BSE/TSE infection.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你在買有機食品。食品本身是有機的（SUS 本身不含高風險成分），但包裝上可能用了微量的膠水，而膠水原料可能來自動物。雖然你實際接觸到這些膠水的機率極低，但作為負責任的製造商，你仍然需要追溯每一層供應鏈，確認風險是否可接受——這就是 BSE/TSE 風險評估的精神。
blocks.en: Imagine you are buying organic food. The food itself is organic (the SUS itself contains no high-risk components), but the packaging may use a trace of glue, and the raw materials of that glue may come from animals. Your actual exposure to that glue is extremely unlikely, yet as a responsible manufacturer you still need to trace every layer of the supply chain and confirm that the risk is acceptable. That is the spirit of a BSE/TSE risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 美國 21 CFR 189.5 與 EMA 410/01 rev 3 均認定：經過嚴格加工的牛脂衍生物不屬於高風險 BSE 材料。但這不代表可以忽略——終端使用者仍須完成並定期更新 BSE/TSE 風險評估文件，特別是在更換供應商或材料時。
blocks.en: Both the US 21 CFR 189.5 and EMA 410/01 rev 3 recognize that rigorously processed tallow derivatives are not high-risk BSE materials. This does not mean the issue can be ignored: the end user must still complete and periodically update the BSE/TSE risk assessment documentation, especially when changing suppliers or materials.

blocks.zh: 這也是 GMP 精神的核心：不是「零風險」，而是「已評估、已記錄、已管控的可接受風險」。
blocks.en: This is also the core of the GMP spirit: not "zero risk", but "acceptable risk that has been assessed, documented and controlled".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使牛脂衍生物被法規認定為低風險，終端使用者仍須執行 BSE/TSE 風險評估？
blocks.en: Why must the end user still perform a BSE/TSE risk assessment even though tallow derivatives are recognized by regulation as low risk?

blocks.zh: 如果 SUS 供應商更換了塑膠樹脂來源，終端使用者應如何更新其 BSE/TSE 風險評估？
blocks.en: If the SUS supplier changes the source of the plastic resin, how should the end user update its BSE/TSE risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 5.8 The Quality Systems of the End User and Supplier 5.8 終端使用者與供應商之品質系統
blocks.en: 5.8 The Quality Systems of the End User and Supplier

blocks.zh: Purchase Specification（採購規格書）：詳細列出終端使用者對 SUS 的品質要求，包括材質、尺寸、微粒限值、滅菌方式等。這是品質管控的第一道防線。
blocks.en: Purchase Specification: Details the end user's quality requirements for the SUS, including materials, dimensions, particulate limits, sterilization method and so on. This is the first line of defense in quality control.

blocks.zh: Inspection Plan（進料檢驗計畫）：規定收貨後需執行哪些檢查——外觀、包裝完整性、證書核對等。
blocks.en: Inspection Plan (incoming inspection plan): Specifies the checks to be performed on receipt, such as appearance, package integrity and certificate verification.

blocks.zh: Supplier Quality Agreement, SQA（供應商品質協議）：正式合約文件，明確雙方在品質、變更管理、偏差處理等方面的權責。這在 SUS 領域尤其重要，因為供應商的任何材料或製程變更都可能影響到最終藥品。
blocks.en: Supplier Quality Agreement (SQA): A formal contractual document that clearly defines the responsibilities of both parties for quality, change management, deviation handling and so on. This is especially important for SUS, because any change by the supplier in materials or processes may affect the final drug product.

blocks.zh: 就像開餐廳需要跟食材供應商簽訂合約一樣——你要規定食材的品質標準（採購規格書），到貨時要檢查新鮮度和包裝（檢驗計畫），還要跟供應商約定：如果換了牧場來源必須提前通知（供應商品質協議）。SUS 的品質管控邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: It is like a restaurant signing a contract with its food suppliers: you set the quality standards for the ingredients (purchase specification), check freshness and packaging on delivery (inspection plan), and agree with the supplier that you must be notified in advance if the farm source changes (supplier quality agreement). The quality control logic for SUS is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: SUS 的測試與放行標準因終端使用者而異，這意味著沒有「一體適用」的標準。每家 CDMO 必須根據自身的製程風險，制定專屬的進料管控程序。
blocks.en: Testing and release criteria for SUS differ from one end user to another, which means there is no "one size fits all" standard. Each CDMO must establish its own incoming control procedures based on the risk of its own processes.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：「現成品」（off-the-shelf）和「客製品」（customized）SUS 都需要有採購規格書和檢驗計畫，不能因為是標準品就省略品質文件。
blocks.en: Note in particular: both "off-the-shelf" and "customized" SUS need a purchase specification and an inspection plan. Quality documentation cannot be omitted just because the item is a standard product.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，你可能同時為多個客戶代工不同藥品，每個藥品對 SUS 的品質要求可能不同。因此，建立分級的進料管控體系非常重要——例如：用於最終充填的 SUS 需要最嚴格的檢驗（包括微粒、內毒素等），而用於緩衝液配製的 SUS 可以採用簡化的檢驗流程。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, you may manufacture different drug products for multiple clients at the same time, and each product may place different quality requirements on the SUS. It is therefore important to establish a tiered incoming control system. For example, an SUS used for final filling requires the strictest inspection (including particulates, endotoxin and so on), whereas an SUS used for buffer preparation can follow a simplified inspection process.

blocks.zh: 供應商品質協議中應包含哪些與 SUS 特別相關的條款？
blocks.en: What clauses specifically relevant to SUS should be included in a supplier quality agreement?

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使是「現成品」SUS 也需要制定採購規格書？
blocks.en: Why is a purchase specification needed even for an "off-the-shelf" SUS?

blocks.zh: 5.9 Quality Management for Single-Use System Implementation 5.9 一次性使用系統實施之品質管理
blocks.en: 5.9 Quality Management for Single-Use System Implementation

blocks.zh: 5.9.1 Determination of Expiration Date and Shelf Life 5.9.1 有效期限與保存期限之確定
blocks.en: 5.9.1 Determination of Expiration Date and Shelf Life

blocks.zh: Shelf Life（保存期限）：SUS 滅菌後到失效之間的有效時間。這個期限必須有數據支持，確保材料不會隨時間劣化、無菌屏障不會失效。
blocks.en: Shelf Life: The period of validity of the SUS from sterilization until expiry. This period must be supported by data showing that the materials do not degrade over time and that the sterile barrier does not fail.

blocks.zh: Real-time Aging（即時老化試驗）：在實際儲存條件下長期觀察材料性能變化，提供最可靠的保存期限數據。
blocks.en: Real-time Aging: Long-term observation of changes in material performance under actual storage conditions, which provides the most reliable shelf life data.

blocks.zh: Accelerated Aging（加速老化試驗）：透過提高溫度等方式加速材料老化，以較短時間預測長期性能。ASTM F1980 是業界廣泛採用的加速老化標準。
blocks.en: Accelerated Aging: Accelerates material aging, for example by raising the temperature, in order to predict long-term performance in a shorter time. ASTM F1980 is the widely adopted industry standard for accelerated aging.

blocks.zh: 「Ready-To-Use」只是行銷術語！這個名稱沒有法規或科學依據來證明其適用性。終端使用者必須自行評估 SUS 是否符合其特定應用的品質要求。切勿因供應商標示「即用型」就省略必要的評估與驗證。
blocks.en: "Ready-To-Use" is only a marketing term! There is no regulatory or scientific basis behind this name to demonstrate suitability. The end user must evaluate for itself whether the SUS meets the quality requirements of its specific application. Never skip the necessary evaluation and validation just because the supplier labels the product "ready to use".

blocks.zh: 想像超市裡的「即食沙拉」——包裝上寫著「即食」（Ready-To-Eat），但如果你經營的是醫院餐廳，你仍然需要檢驗食材來源、微生物指標、保存溫度等，不能單純相信包裝上的標示。SUS 的「Ready-To-Use」也是同樣道理。
blocks.en: Think of a "ready-to-eat salad" in a supermarket: the package says "Ready-To-Eat", but if you run a hospital kitchen you still need to check the origin of the ingredients, microbiological indicators, storage temperature and so on, and you cannot simply trust the label. The same applies to "Ready-To-Use" for SUS.

blocks.zh: 為什麼即時老化試驗（real-time aging）比加速老化試驗提供更可靠的數據？
blocks.en: Why does real-time aging provide more reliable data than accelerated aging?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 SUS 供應商聲稱其產品「Ready-To-Use」，終端使用者還需要執行哪些評估？
blocks.en: If an SUS supplier claims its product is "Ready-To-Use", what further evaluations must the end user perform?

blocks.zh: 5.9.2 Dealing with Particulates 5.9.2 微粒處理
blocks.en: 5.9.2 Dealing with Particulates

blocks.zh: Particulates（微粒）：包括嵌入塑膠本體的顆粒、鬆散的粒子或纖維。在藥品生產中，微粒可能對患者安全構成風險，尤其是注射劑。
blocks.en: Particulates: Include particles embedded in the plastic body, loose particles or fibers. In drug manufacturing, particulates can pose a patient safety risk, especially for injectable products.

blocks.zh: USP <788>（注射劑微粒檢測）：美國藥典標準，規定注射劑中不可見微粒的限值。
blocks.en: USP <788> (Particulate Matter in Injections): The US Pharmacopeia standard that sets limits for subvisible particles in injections.

blocks.zh: USP <790>（眼用製劑微粒檢測）：針對眼科藥品的更嚴格微粒標準。
blocks.en: USP <790> (Particulate Testing for Ophthalmic Preparations): A stricter particulate standard for ophthalmic drug products.

blocks.zh: 微粒管控的嚴格程度取決於 SUS 在製程中的位置：
blocks.en: The stringency of particulate control depends on where the SUS is located in the process:

blocks.zh: 最終過濾器上游：微粒要求可以較寬鬆，因為下游還有過濾步驟
blocks.en: Upstream of the final filter: Particulate requirements can be more relaxed, because a filtration step follows downstream

blocks.zh: 最終過濾器下游：必須執行嚴格的微粒限值管控，因為已無後續過濾保護
blocks.en: Downstream of the final filter: Strict particulate limits must be applied, because no further filtration protects the product

blocks.zh: 這就是「風險分級管控」的具體體現——在最關鍵的位置投入最多的管控資源。
blocks.en: This is a concrete expression of "risk-tiered control": the most control resources are invested at the most critical points.

blocks.zh: 就像家裡的淨水系統：廚房水龍頭前還有濾芯（最終過濾器），所以進水管（上游 SUS）的水質要求可以稍寬；但如果你直接從水龍頭喝水而沒有濾芯（下游 SUS，無後續過濾），那進水管的水質標準就必須達到飲用水等級。
blocks.en: It is like the water purification system at home: there is a filter cartridge (final filter) in front of the kitchen tap, so the water quality requirement for the inlet pipe (upstream SUS) can be a little looser. If you drank straight from the tap with no cartridge (downstream SUS, no further filtration), the inlet pipe water would have to meet drinking-water standards.

blocks.zh: 為什麼微粒管控可以從「每批取樣」簡化為「定期稽核模型 SUS」？這樣做需要什麼前提條件？
blocks.en: Why can particulate control be reduced from "sampling every lot" to "periodic auditing of a model SUS"? What prerequisites are needed for this?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 SUS 用於大量注射劑的最終充填，應符合哪個藥典標準？
blocks.en: If an SUS is used for the final filling of a large-volume injectable, which pharmacopeial standard should it meet?

blocks.zh: 5.9.3 Sanitation and Sterilization 5.9.3 清潔消毒與滅菌
blocks.en: 5.9.3 Sanitation and Sterilization

blocks.zh: Bioburden Control（生物負荷控制）：指控制微生物污染的程度。不同應用場景對生物負荷的要求差異極大——從非無菌緩衝液配製（允許一定生物負荷）到最終無菌充填（需經驗證的無菌保證）。
blocks.en: Bioburden Control: Refers to controlling the level of microbial contamination. Bioburden requirements differ greatly between applications, from non-sterile buffer preparation (a certain bioburden is allowed) to final sterile filling (validated sterility assurance is required).

blocks.zh: 決定清潔和滅菌策略的關鍵因素包括：製程類型、接觸流體的性質、接觸時間、以及儲存條件。終端使用者必須根據這些因素的綜合評估來決定適當的微生物品質管控措施——這體現了 GMP 中「基於風險的方法」（Risk-Based Approach）。
blocks.en: The key factors that determine the sanitization and sterilization strategy are: process type, nature of the fluid contacted, contact time and storage conditions. The end user must decide on appropriate microbial quality control measures based on a combined assessment of these factors. This reflects the "risk-based approach" in GMP.

blocks.zh: 5.9.4 Bioburden Control 5.9.4 生物負荷管制
blocks.en: 5.9.4 Bioburden Control

blocks.zh: SAL（Sterility Assurance Level, 無菌保證水準）：表示滅菌後存在活微生物的概率。SAL 10-6 表示每一百萬個產品中最多只有一個可能是非無菌的。
blocks.en: SAL (Sterility Assurance Level): The probability that a viable microorganism is present after sterilization. An SAL of 10-6 means that at most one in a million products may be non-sterile.

blocks.zh: Gamma Irradiation（伽瑪射線照射）：利用放射性同位素（通常是鈷-60）發出的伽瑪射線穿透塑膠材料，破壞微生物 DNA 以達到滅菌效果。
blocks.en: Gamma Irradiation: Uses gamma rays emitted by a radioactive isotope (usually cobalt-60) to penetrate plastic materials and destroy microbial DNA, achieving sterilization.

blocks.zh: 劑量與 SAL 的關係
blocks.en: Relationship between dose and SAL

blocks.zh:
低劑量照射：8-10 kGy → 可將固有生物負荷降至零
                        （但不足以聲稱 SAL 10⁻⁶）

高劑量照射：≥25 kGy  → 可達到 SAL 10⁻⁶
                        （等同於經驗證的無菌水準）
                        （免除定期滅菌稽核的需求）
blocks.en:
Low-dose irradiation: 8-10 kGy → can reduce the inherent bioburden to zero
                        (but is not sufficient to claim an SAL of 10⁻⁶)

High-dose irradiation: ≥25 kGy  → can achieve an SAL of 10⁻⁶
                        (equivalent to a validated sterility level)
                        (exempts the need for periodic sterilization dose audits)

blocks.zh: 使用 ≥25 kGy 照射劑量的策略優勢在於：不需要執行完整的滅菌驗證方案和定期無菌稽核，就能達到統計上等同於 SAL 10<sup>-6</sup> 的無菌保證水準。這對下游緩衝液和中間體儲存等應用特別實用。
blocks.en: The strategic advantage of using an irradiation dose of ≥25 kGy is that a sterility assurance level statistically equivalent to an SAL of 10<sup>-6</sup> can be achieved without running a full sterilization validation program and periodic sterility audits. This is particularly practical for applications such as downstream buffer and intermediate storage.

blocks.zh: 但要注意：更高的照射劑量也會增加材料劣化和可萃取物（Extractables）生成的風險，這需要在風險評估中一併考量。
blocks.en: Note, however, that a higher irradiation dose also increases the risk of material degradation and the generation of extractables, which must be considered together in the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 為什麼實務上使用 >25 kGy 而不是 8-10 kGy 就足以消除生物負荷的劑量？
blocks.en: Why is a dose of >25 kGy used in practice, when 8-10 kGy is sufficient to eliminate the bioburden?

blocks.zh: 高劑量照射可能帶來哪些「副作用」？如何在風險評估中平衡這些因素？
blocks.en: What "side effects" can high-dose irradiation bring? How should these factors be balanced in the risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 5.10 Sterilization 5.10 滅菌
blocks.en: 5.10 Sterilization

blocks.zh: 5.10.1 Irradiation Sterilization 5.10.1 輻射滅菌
blocks.en: 5.10.1 Irradiation Sterilization

blocks.zh: ISO 11137（醫療產品輻射滅菌標準）：雖然最初是為醫療器材制定的，但已被 SUS 業界廣泛採用。這是目前 SUS 照射滅菌最主要的參考標準。
blocks.en: ISO 11137 (Sterilization of health care products - Radiation): Although originally developed for medical devices, it has been widely adopted by the SUS industry. It is currently the main reference standard for SUS irradiation sterilization.

blocks.zh: VD max（驗證劑量最大值法）：一種劑量確認方法。先以低劑量（8-10 kGy）照射代表性產品並進行無菌測試，再根據結果計算達到 SAL 10-6 所需的滅菌劑量。
blocks.en: VD max (maximum verification dose method): A dose substantiation method. Representative products are first irradiated at a low dose (8-10 kGy) and tested for sterility, and the sterilization dose needed to achieve an SAL of 10-6 is then calculated from the results.

blocks.zh: Quarterly Dose Audit（每季劑量稽核）：供應商必須每季對每個產品家族執行劑量驗證，確保生物負荷水準未發生顯著變化。
blocks.en: Quarterly Dose Audit: The supplier must perform a dose verification for each product family every quarter to ensure that the bioburden level has not changed significantly.

blocks.zh: 照射滅菌就像用 X 光機掃描行李：X 光可以穿透行李箱（塑膠外殼），不需要打開箱子就能達到「檢查」效果。同樣地，伽瑪射線可以穿透 SUS 的塑膠材料，在不打開密封系統的情況下完成滅菌——這正是照射滅菌對複雜 SUS 系統最大的優勢。
blocks.en: Irradiation sterilization is like scanning luggage with an X-ray machine: X-rays penetrate the suitcase (the plastic shell) and achieve the "inspection" without opening it. In the same way, gamma rays penetrate the plastic of the SUS and sterilize it without opening the sealed system. This is the greatest advantage of irradiation sterilization for complex SUS.

blocks.zh: 照射滅菌驗證的核心流程：
blocks.en: Core flow of irradiation sterilization validation:

blocks.zh: 選擇代表性產品（或可行的樣品部分）
blocks.en: Select representative products (or a feasible portion of a sample)

blocks.zh: 測定平均生物負荷水準
blocks.en: Determine the average bioburden level

blocks.zh: 以低驗證劑量（8-10 kGy）照射後進行無菌測試
blocks.en: Irradiate at a low verification dose (8-10 kGy) and then perform sterility testing

blocks.zh: 計算達到 SAL 10<sup>-6</sup> 所需的正式滅菌劑量
blocks.en: Calculate the formal sterilization dose required to achieve an SAL of 10<sup>-6</sup>

blocks.zh: 每季執行劑量稽核以確認持續合規
blocks.en: Perform a dose audit every quarter to confirm continued compliance

blocks.zh: 終端使用者必須確認供應商的驗證方法適用於其特定的 SUS 配置。
blocks.en: The end user must confirm that the supplier's validation method is applicable to its specific SUS configuration.

blocks.zh: 為什麼照射滅菌特別適合複雜的 SUS 組件？相比蒸氣滅菌有何優勢？
blocks.en: Why is irradiation sterilization particularly suitable for complex SUS assemblies? What advantages does it have over steam sterilization?

blocks.zh: 當代表性產品因尺寸過大而無法直接測試時，可以使用什麼替代方法？
blocks.en: What alternative method can be used when a representative product is too large to be tested directly?

blocks.zh: 每季劑量稽核的目的是什麼？如果稽核發現生物負荷增加，應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of the quarterly dose audit? What action should be taken if the audit finds an increase in bioburden?

blocks.zh: 5.10.2 Sterilization with Moist Heat 5.10.2 濕熱滅菌
blocks.en: 5.10.2 Sterilization with Moist Heat

blocks.zh: SIP（就地滅菌）：利用蒸氣對連接介面進行滅菌。由於塑膠材料耐溫有限，SUS 無法像不鏽鋼設備那樣全面進行 SIP，但可透過特殊設計的 Steam-to 或 Steam-through 連接器，對 SUS 與不鏽鋼槽體的接合處進行蒸氣滅菌。
blocks.en: SIP (Steam-in-Place): Uses steam to sterilize connection interfaces. Because plastic materials have limited temperature resistance, SUS cannot undergo full SIP the way stainless steel equipment can, but specially designed steam-to or steam-through connectors allow the junction between the SUS and a stainless steel tank to be steam sterilized.

blocks.zh: EtO（環氧乙烷）滅菌：較少用於 SUS，主要因為會產生有害副產物（氯乙醇、乙二醇），且氣體可能殘留在過濾器基質中。
blocks.en: EtO (ethylene oxide) sterilization: Rarely used for SUS, mainly because it produces harmful by-products (ethylene chlorohydrin, ethylene glycol) and the gas may be retained in the filter matrix.

blocks.zh: Resterilization（再滅菌）：SUS 設計上不支援再滅菌。多次高壓滅菌或照射會導致材料劣化、可萃取物增加、保存期縮短。
blocks.en: Resterilization: SUS are not designed to support resterilization. Repeated autoclaving or irradiation leads to material degradation, increased extractables and a shorter shelf life.

blocks.zh: SUS 滅菌方法的選擇決策樹：
blocks.en: Decision tree for selecting an SUS sterilization method:

blocks.zh: 優先選擇：伽瑪射線照射（最適合預組裝 SUS）
blocks.en: First choice: Gamma irradiation (best suited to pre-assembled SUS)

blocks.zh: 終端使用者自組裝：高壓滅菌（Autoclaving）
blocks.en: Assembled by the end user: Autoclaving

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼介面連接：SIP（蒸氣到連接器）
blocks.en: Stainless steel interface connections: SIP (steam-to-connector)

blocks.zh: 不建議：EtO 氣體滅菌（副產物風險）
blocks.en: Not recommended: EtO gas sterilization (by-product risk)

blocks.zh: 禁止：再滅菌（材料劣化嚴重）
blocks.en: Prohibited: Resterilization (severe material degradation)

blocks.zh: SUS 就像免洗餐具——設計上就是一次性使用的。你不會把用過的免洗筷放進洗碗機再用一次，因為材質無法承受反覆清洗和高溫。同理，SUS 不設計為可再滅菌——強行再滅菌就像把紙杯放進烤箱，只會造成材料變質和安全風險。
blocks.en: An SUS is like disposable tableware: it is designed for single use. You would not put used disposable chopsticks in the dishwasher and use them again, because the material cannot withstand repeated washing and high temperature. Likewise, SUS are not designed to be resterilized, and forcing resterilization is like putting a paper cup in the oven: it only causes material degradation and safety risks.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，如果 SUS 在使用前發現滅菌包裝破損或過期，正確的做法是整套報廢而非嘗試再滅菌。這也是為什麼庫存管理（先進先出 FIFO）和保存期限監控在 SUS 管理中如此重要。一套過期的客製化 SUS 可能需要數週才能重新訂購，直接影響生產排程。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, if the sterile packaging of an SUS is found to be damaged or expired before use, the correct action is to scrap the entire assembly rather than attempt resterilization. This is also why inventory management (first in, first out, FIFO) and shelf life monitoring are so important in SUS management. An expired customized SUS may take weeks to reorder, directly affecting the production schedule.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EtO 氣體滅菌不常用於 SUS？列舉至少兩個原因。
blocks.en: Why is EtO gas sterilization not commonly used for SUS? List at least two reasons.

blocks.zh: Steam-to-connector 的設計如何解決塑膠材料無法耐受高壓蒸氣的限制？
blocks.en: How does the steam-to-connector design overcome the limitation that plastic materials cannot withstand high-pressure steam?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 SUS 已經過伽瑪照射滅菌但包裝破損，可以用高壓滅菌重新滅菌嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: If an SUS has been sterilized by gamma irradiation but its packaging is damaged, can it be resterilized by autoclaving? Why or why not?

blocks.zh: 5.10.3 Sensor Technology 5.10.3 感測器技術
blocks.en: 5.10.3 Sensor Technology

blocks.zh: SU Sensor（一次性感測器）：專為一次性使用設計的製程感測器，常見於 pH 和溶氧（DO）的測量。相比傳統可重複使用的感測器，SU 感測器只經歷一次滅菌循環，可能具有更高的可靠性。
blocks.en: SU Sensor (single-use sensor): A process sensor designed for single use, commonly for measuring pH and dissolved oxygen (DO). Compared with traditional reusable sensors, SU sensors undergo only one sterilization cycle and may therefore be more reliable.

blocks.zh: Optical Sensor（光學感測器）：利用浸入製程流體中的化學貼片（Chemical Patch）上的光學變化來測量參數。使用批次專用校準標準品而非傳統的零點/跨距校準。
blocks.en: Optical Sensor: Measures parameters through optical changes in a chemical patch immersed in the process fluid. Lot-specific calibration standards are used instead of the traditional zero/span calibration.

blocks.zh: Photo Bleaching（光漂白）：光學感測器的化學貼片在長時間光照下可能失去螢光強度，導致測量漂移。
blocks.en: Photo Bleaching: The chemical patch of an optical sensor may lose fluorescence intensity under prolonged light exposure, causing measurement drift.

blocks.zh: 傳統可重複使用的感測器就像一把反覆經過高溫洗碗機清洗的菜刀——每次清洗都會造成些許磨損。而 SU 感測器就像一把全新的手術刀——只用一次，所以性能最佳。這也是為什麼 SU 感測器在某些方面可能比可重複使用的感測器更可靠。
blocks.en: A traditional reusable sensor is like a kitchen knife washed again and again in a hot dishwasher: each wash causes a little wear. An SU sensor is like a brand-new scalpel: it is used only once, so its performance is at its best. This is why SU sensors may be more reliable than reusable sensors in some respects.

blocks.zh: 選擇 SU 感測器時必須評估的四大面向：
blocks.en: Four aspects that must be evaluated when selecting an SU sensor:

blocks.zh: 準確度與重複性：是否符合製程要求？
blocks.en: Accuracy and repeatability: Do they meet process requirements?

blocks.zh: 滅菌相容性：與 SUS 的滅菌方法是否相容？
blocks.en: Sterilization compatibility: Is the sensor compatible with the SUS sterilization method?

blocks.zh: 保存期限：感測器本身（尤其是化學貼片）的有效期是多久？
blocks.en: Shelf life: What is the shelf life of the sensor itself (especially the chemical patch)?

blocks.zh: 使用壽命：在製程條件下能穩定運作多長時間？
blocks.en: Service life: How long can it operate stably under process conditions?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 SU 感測器可能比傳統可重複使用的感測器更可靠？
blocks.en: Why may SU sensors be more reliable than traditional reusable sensors?

blocks.zh: 光學式 pH 感測器的校準方式與傳統電極式有何不同？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: How does the calibration of an optical pH sensor differ from that of a traditional electrode-based sensor? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 5.10.4 Qualification and Validation 5.10.4 確效與驗證
blocks.en: 5.10.4 Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: Process Validation（製程驗證）：終端使用者的責任，必須證明 SUS 在其特定製程中能持續且可靠地運作。供應商的確認數據是起點，但不是終點。
blocks.en: Process Validation: The responsibility of the end user, who must demonstrate that the SUS performs consistently and reliably in its specific process. The supplier's qualification data is a starting point, not an end point.

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Approach（基於風險的方法）：驗證的深度和廣度應與風險成正比——高風險應用（如最終充填）需要最全面的驗證。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Approach: The depth and breadth of validation should be proportional to risk. High-risk applications (such as final filling) require the most comprehensive validation.

blocks.zh: Media Fill（培養基充填模擬）：使用培養基代替藥品進行模擬充填，以驗證無菌製程的有效性。SUS 組件必須納入培養基充填計畫中。
blocks.en: Media Fill: Uses culture medium in place of the drug product to simulate filling and verify the effectiveness of the aseptic process. SUS components must be included in the media fill program.

blocks.zh: SUS 驗證的六大關注重點：
blocks.en: Six key focus areas for SUS validation:

blocks.zh: 培養基充填：SUS 和替代設計須納入 Media Fill 計畫
blocks.en: Media fill: SUS and alternative designs must be included in the media fill program

blocks.zh: 過濾系統設計：需考慮使用前潤濕和完整性測試的需求
blocks.en: Filtration system design: The need for pre-use wetting and integrity testing must be considered

blocks.zh: 洩漏風險：因無法直接測試，需從製造、運輸、操作流程保證
blocks.en: Leak risk: Because direct testing is not possible, assurance must come from manufacturing, transportation and handling procedures

blocks.zh: 浸出物測試：最終藥品配方可能需要實際浸出物測試
blocks.en: Leachables testing: Actual leachables testing may be needed for the final drug product formulation

blocks.zh: 專利連接：需審查供應商驗證數據的適用性
blocks.en: Proprietary connections: The applicability of the supplier's validation data must be reviewed

blocks.zh: 操作人員培訓：SUS 的正確處理和操作須經確認
blocks.en: Operator training: Correct handling and operation of the SUS must be qualified

blocks.zh: 買一台預組裝的烤箱（預組裝 SUS），廠商會提供性能測試報告（供應商確認數據）。但這不代表你不需要在自己的廚房試烤——你仍然要確認在你的電壓、你的擺放位置、你的食譜下，這台烤箱能正常運作（製程驗證）。供應商的數據是起點，而非終點。
blocks.en: When you buy a pre-assembled oven (a pre-assembled SUS), the manufacturer provides a performance test report (supplier qualification data). That does not mean you do not need to test-bake in your own kitchen: you still have to confirm that the oven works properly with your voltage, your placement and your recipes (process validation). The supplier's data is a starting point, not an end point.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，驗證 SUS 的成本和時間投入不容忽視。建議建立「SUS 驗證平台」——將常用的 SUS 配置進行一次性全面驗證（包括 E&L、微粒、無菌性、培養基充填），之後新專案如使用相同配置，可引用平台驗證數據，大幅縮短專案啟動時間。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the cost and time of validating SUS cannot be ignored. It is advisable to establish an "SUS validation platform": commonly used SUS configurations are comprehensively validated once (including E&L, particulates, sterility and media fill), and new projects that use the same configuration can then reference the platform validation data, greatly shortening project start-up time.

blocks.zh: 為什麼終端使用者不能完全依賴供應商的確認數據？
blocks.en: Why can the end user not rely entirely on the supplier's qualification data?

blocks.zh: SUS 為什麼必須納入培養基充填計畫？如果不納入會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must SUS be included in the media fill program? What risks arise if they are not?

blocks.zh: 「驗證過程中發現的缺陷可透過額外的針對性檢查來緩解」——請舉一個具體例子。
blocks.en: "Deficiencies found during validation can be mitigated by additional targeted checks." Give a specific example.

blocks.zh: 5.11 Integrity 5.11 完整性
blocks.en: 5.11 Integrity

blocks.zh: 5.11.1 Testing an SUS for Leaks 5.11.1 SUS 洩漏測試
blocks.en: 5.11.1 Testing an SUS for Leaks

blocks.zh: Structural Integrity（結構完整性）：SUS 的容器不會洩漏——這是最基本的品質要求。完整性測試的嚴格程度取決於應用風險。
blocks.en: Structural Integrity: The SUS container does not leak. This is the most basic quality requirement. The stringency of integrity testing depends on the risk of the application.

blocks.zh: Microbial Ingress（微生物侵入）：當 SUS 用於儲存培養基或無菌製品時，任何缺陷都可能導致微生物進入，破壞無菌性。
blocks.en: Microbial Ingress: When an SUS is used to store culture medium or sterile products, any defect may allow microorganisms to enter and compromise sterility.

blocks.zh: 完整性測試的風險分級策略：
blocks.en: Risk-tiered strategy for integrity testing:

blocks.zh: 低風險（樣品袋、緩衝液袋）：依賴供應商測試數據和適當的操作訓練即可
blocks.en: Low risk (sample bags, buffer bags): Reliance on supplier test data and appropriate operator training is sufficient

blocks.zh: 中風險（上游製程）：驗證時確認供應商聲明，後續依據文件接受
blocks.en: Medium risk (upstream processes): Confirm the supplier's claims during validation, then accept based on documentation

blocks.zh: 高風險（疫苗生產、活病毒）：建議對每個系統進行個別測試
blocks.en: High risk (vaccine production, live virus): Individual testing of each system is recommended

blocks.zh: 最高風險（最終藥品容器）：最嚴格的測試要求
blocks.en: Highest risk (final drug product container): The strictest testing requirements

blocks.zh: 洩漏偵測就像偵探辦案：先在容器中注水（犯罪現場保全），然後在吸水性表面上找到濕點（找到證據），再對照袋子上的位置找到漏點（鎖定嫌疑人），最後用放大鏡檢查是穿刺、撕裂還是材料缺陷（確認動機和手法）。追蹤每次洩漏的位置，就像建立犯罪熱點地圖——幫助你找出系統性的根本原因。
blocks.en: Leak detection is like detective work: first fill the container with water (preserve the crime scene), then find wet spots on an absorbent surface (find the evidence), match them to positions on the bag to locate the leak (identify the suspect), and finally use a magnifying glass to see whether it is a puncture, tear or material defect (establish motive and method). Tracking the location of every leak is like building a crime hot-spot map, helping you find systematic root causes.

blocks.zh: 洩漏測試的實務流程：
blocks.en: Practical leak testing procedure:

blocks.zh: 在容器/桶內以水填滿 SUS 袋至最大容量
blocks.en: Fill the SUS bag with water to maximum capacity in its container/tote

blocks.zh: 如漏點不明顯，將裝水的袋子移到吸水表面（紙板或紙張）上
blocks.en: If the leak point is not obvious, move the water-filled bag onto an absorbent surface (cardboard or paper)

blocks.zh: 辨識吸水表面上的濕點位置，對照袋子上的相應位置
blocks.en: Identify the wet spots on the absorbent surface and match them to the corresponding positions on the bag

blocks.zh: 檢查容器/桶內是否有尖銳物可能刺穿袋子
blocks.en: Check the container/tote for sharp objects that could puncture the bag

blocks.zh: 用放大鏡檢查漏點類型（穿刺、撕裂、折痕、針孔）
blocks.en: Use a magnifying glass to examine the type of leak (puncture, tear, crease, pinhole)

blocks.zh: 記錄並追蹤所有洩漏位置，進行失效模式分析
blocks.en: Record and track all leak locations and perform failure mode analysis

blocks.zh: 為什麼疫苗生產中活病毒的 SUS 完整性要求特別嚴格？
blocks.en: Why are the integrity requirements for SUS holding live virus in vaccine production particularly strict?

blocks.zh: 運輸後測試（Post-shipment testing）為什麼需要納入完整性評估？
blocks.en: Why must post-shipment testing be included in the integrity evaluation?

blocks.zh: 如果發現洩漏是由製造缺陷造成的，終端使用者應該採取哪些步驟？
blocks.en: If a leak is found to be caused by a manufacturing defect, what steps should the end user take?

blocks.zh: 5.11.2 Leak Prevention in an SUS 5.11.2 SUS 洩漏預防
blocks.en: 5.11.2 Leak Prevention in an SUS

blocks.zh: Leak-Investigation Procedure（洩漏調查程序）：標準化的報告程序，記錄洩漏位置、環境條件、流體組成、機械事件和失效模式。這些數據是趨勢分析的基礎。
blocks.en: Leak-Investigation Procedure: A standardized reporting procedure that records the leak location, environmental conditions, fluid composition, mechanical events and failure mode. These data are the basis for trend analysis.

blocks.zh: Trend Analysis（趨勢分析）：透過系統性收集和分析洩漏數據，找出重複出現的模式和根本原因——例如案例中發現洩漏多發生在袋子頂部和底部（操作人員拿取的位置）。
blocks.en: Trend Analysis: Systematic collection and analysis of leak data to identify recurring patterns and root causes. For example, in the case study the leaks occurred mostly at the top and bottom of the bag (where operators grip it).

blocks.zh: Deployment（部署）：指將 SUS 組裝並準備就緒以供特定應用使用的所有動手操作步驟的總和。標準化的部署流程是 SUS 實施成功的關鍵因素。
blocks.en: Deployment: The sum of all hands-on steps involved in assembling the SUS and preparing it for use in a specific application. A standardized deployment process is a key factor in the success of SUS implementation.

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家物流公司，運送液體產品。如果某條路線的包裹經常破損，你不會只是每次賠償了事——你會建立破損報告系統，追蹤每個破損的位置、原因和時間，最終發現是搬運工在卸貨時總是抓同一個角落導致破損。解決方案：培訓搬運工正確的搬運方式 + 改善包裝設計。SUS 洩漏預防的邏輯完全一樣。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a logistics company shipping liquid products. If packages on a particular route are often damaged, you would not simply pay compensation each time. You would set up a damage reporting system, track the location, cause and time of each damage, and eventually discover that the handlers always grab the same corner when unloading. The solution: train the handlers in correct handling and improve the packaging design. The logic of SUS leak prevention is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 案例研究的關鍵發現：將洩漏位置「地圖化」後，發現洩漏集中在袋子頂部和底部——正是操作人員拿取的地方。這個發現直接指向根本原因（操作不當）而非材料缺陷。
blocks.en: Key finding of the case study: after "mapping" the leak locations, the leaks were found to be concentrated at the top and bottom of the bag, exactly where operators grip it. This finding pointed directly to the root cause (improper handling) rather than a material defect.

blocks.zh: 改善措施雙管齊下：
blocks.en: Improvement measures on two fronts:

blocks.zh: 終端使用者端：操作人員培訓、移除尖銳物、改善搬運設備、確保袋子正確放入容器
blocks.en: End user side: Operator training, removal of sharp objects, improved handling equipment, ensuring the bag is correctly placed in its container

blocks.zh: 供應商合作端：分享洩漏調查報告、採用供應商改善方法、導入更耐用的設計
blocks.en: Supplier collaboration side: Sharing leak investigation reports, adopting the supplier's improvement methods, introducing more durable designs

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，建立 SUS 洩漏追蹤系統的具體做法：
blocks.en: Specific practices for establishing an SUS leak tracking system in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: 建立標準化的洩漏調查表單（含位置圖示、照片、環境數據）
blocks.en: Create a standardized leak investigation form (including location diagram, photographs and environmental data)

blocks.zh: 每月彙整洩漏數據進行趨勢分析
blocks.en: Compile leak data monthly for trend analysis

blocks.zh: 設定洩漏率 KPI 和告警閾值
blocks.en: Set a leak rate KPI and alert thresholds

blocks.zh: 定期與供應商召開品質改善會議，分享洩漏分析結果
blocks.en: Hold regular quality improvement meetings with the supplier to share leak analysis results

blocks.zh: 將洩漏預防納入操作人員的年度複訓計畫
blocks.en: Include leak prevention in operators' annual retraining plan

blocks.zh: 為什麼洩漏調查報告需要包含「周圍溫度條件」和「流體組成」？這些資訊如何幫助找到根本原因？
blocks.en: Why must a leak investigation report include "ambient temperature conditions" and "fluid composition"? How does this information help find the root cause?

blocks.zh: 案例中發現洩漏多發生在袋子頂部和底部，這指向什麼根本原因？你會建議什麼改善措施？
blocks.en: The case study found that leaks occurred mostly at the top and bottom of the bag. What root cause does this point to? What improvement measures would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 什麼是「Deployment」？為什麼它被認為是 SUS 實施的成功關鍵因素？
blocks.en: What is "Deployment"? Why is it considered a key success factor for SUS implementation?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: BSE/TSE 風險：SUS 整體屬於低風險，但含牛脂衍生添加劑（如硬脂酸鈣）的塑膠樹脂仍需完成風險評估。美國 21 CFR 189.5 和 EMA 410/01 均認定經嚴格加工的牛脂衍生物不屬於高風險 BSE 材料。
blocks.en: BSE/TSE risk: SUS as a whole are low risk, but plastic resins containing tallow-derived additives (such as calcium stearate) still require a completed risk assessment. The US 21 CFR 189.5 and EMA 410/01 both recognize that rigorously processed tallow derivatives are not high-risk BSE materials.

blocks.zh: 品質系統：終端使用者須建立完整的進料管控體系，包括採購規格書、檢驗計畫和供應商品質協議（SQA）。不同 SUS 的測試與放行標準因應用而異。
blocks.en: Quality systems: The end user must establish a complete incoming control system, including a purchase specification, an inspection plan and a supplier quality agreement (SQA). Testing and release criteria differ between SUS depending on the application.

blocks.zh: 有效期限與保存期限：須有即時或加速老化試驗數據支持。「Ready-To-Use」僅為行銷術語，不具法規或科學效力。
blocks.en: Expiration date and shelf life: Must be supported by real-time or accelerated aging data. "Ready-To-Use" is only a marketing term and has no regulatory or scientific standing.

blocks.zh: 微粒管控：依據 SUS 在製程中的位置（最終過濾器上游 vs 下游）實施風險分級管控，下游組件須符合 USP <788>/<790> 標準。
blocks.en: Particulate control: Apply risk-tiered control according to the position of the SUS in the process (upstream vs downstream of the final filter); downstream components must meet USP <788>/<790> standards.

blocks.zh: 生物負荷控制：低劑量照射（8-10 kGy）可消除固有生物負荷，但 ≥25 kGy 才能達到 SAL 10-6 的無菌保證水準。
blocks.en: Bioburden control: Low-dose irradiation (8-10 kGy) can eliminate the inherent bioburden, but only ≥25 kGy achieves a sterility assurance level of SAL 10-6.

blocks.zh: 滅菌方法：伽瑪照射是 SUS 首選滅菌方式；SIP 適用於不鏽鋼介面連接；EtO 因副產物風險不建議使用；SUS 不設計為可再滅菌。
blocks.en: Sterilization methods: Gamma irradiation is the preferred SUS sterilization method; SIP is suitable for stainless steel interface connections; EtO is not recommended because of by-product risk; SUS are not designed to be resterilized.

blocks.zh: 感測器技術：SU 感測器只經歷一次滅菌循環，可能比可重複使用的感測器更可靠，但須注意光漂白和漂移等限制。
blocks.en: Sensor technology: SU sensors undergo only one sterilization cycle and may be more reliable than reusable sensors, but limitations such as photo bleaching and drift must be noted.

blocks.zh: 確認與驗證：終端使用者負責製程驗證，須涵蓋材料建構、測試程序、滅菌方法，且 SUS 須納入培養基充填計畫。
blocks.en: Qualification and validation: The end user is responsible for process validation, which must cover material construction, test procedures and sterilization method, and SUS must be included in the media fill program.

blocks.zh: 完整性與洩漏：完整性測試需依風險分級——從低風險（依賴供應商數據）到高風險（個別系統測試）。建立標準化洩漏調查程序和趨勢分析是預防洩漏的關鍵。
blocks.en: Integrity and leaks: Integrity testing should be risk-tiered, from low risk (reliance on supplier data) to high risk (individual system testing). Establishing a standardized leak investigation procedure and trend analysis is the key to preventing leaks.

blocks.zh: 洩漏預防：案例研究顯示操作不當是洩漏的主要根本原因。標準化的部署（Deployment）流程和操作人員培訓是 SUS 實施成功的關鍵因素。
blocks.en: Leak prevention: The case study shows that improper handling is the main root cause of leaks. A standardized deployment process and operator training are key success factors for SUS implementation.
